subject: Invoice intake: multi-PO, VAT line handling, and portal/email fallback
messages:
From: Tom Yates <tom.yates@lumenhealth.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on invoice submission (portal vs email) + VAT lines

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We're starting to bill Redwood for our September run-rate and ran into two issues while preparing the first batch:

1) Our ERP can either post invoices to a vendor portal (we can push CSV) or email a PDF to accounts-payable. Which should we prefer? We saw in onboarding notes both options exist and wanted to confirm the acceptance and a suggested fallback.

2) We have several invoices that need to reference multiple POs on one invoice (sometimes 2–4 PO numbers). What's your preferred convention so your AP can auto-match? Example: should we: (a) include all PO numbers in a single PO column separated by semicolon, or (b) include line-level PO number repeated on multiple lines?

3) VAT/tax: some line items have VAT at 20% and some are VAT-exempt. Can you confirm how to format tax-rate + tax-amount per line in the CSV so your system doesn't aggregate incorrectly?

I'm attaching a sample invoice (PDF) and our CSV export. Can you share the exact column layout you expect and any filename/ACK requirements?

Thanks,
Tom
Lumen Health — AP

Quick notes from me: we prefer portal pushes for structured data but allow email fallback (PDF) for early invoices if they can't push CSV yet. Need a clear minimal CSV schema and filename/ACK expectations. Can you draft a short template we can send them?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Yates <tom.yates@lumenhealth.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Questions on invoice submission (portal vs email) + VAT lines

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear examples and attachments. Sorry for the initial delay. Below is the recommended intake approach and a compact CSV schema you can use. I'm attaching a more detailed template (redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) with a sample row.

Summary / channel preference:
- Preferred: Portal CSV push (secure upload to our vendor portal) — this gives fastest auto-ack and matching. Portal guide: https://redwood.app/invoice-portal/onboarding/4312
- Fallback: Single-PDF email to ap@redwood.com is allowed for the first two invoices as we get you onboarded. PDFs must include a machine-readable first page (invoice summary table) to help ops.

PO matching options (we support both):
- Preferred for portal CSV: line-level PO column. Each line in the CSV should include the PO number that the line relates to. This is the most robust for auto-matching.
- Alternate (accepted): multiple PO numbers in a PO column separated by a semicolon (e.g., PO12345;PO12346). If you use semicolons we will attempt to match any PO listed but line-level mapping is better.

VAT / tax handling (important):
- Required columns for tax: tax_rate_percent, tax_amount_local.
- tax_rate_percent: numeric (no % sign) per line, e.g., 20.0 or 0.0 for exempt lines.
- tax_amount_local: currency amount for tax on that line, must match (line_total * tax_rate_percent / 100) within rounding tolerance.
- For invoices where VAT is applied at invoice level but not on each line, include two rows: line items as usual with tax_rate_percent=0 and one "tax-summary" line with description=VAT 20% and tax_rate_percent=20.0 and tax_amount_local populated. Portal will map that as invoice-level tax.

Filename and ACK format:
- Preferred file name: vendorname_YYYYMMDD_invoice_INVNUM.csv (e.g., lumenhealth_20260901_invoice_INV6789.csv)
- Portal: instant ACK with matching GUID in header.
- Email (PDF fallback): please include the header line "X-Redwood-File-Ref: vendorname-INVNUM" in the email body or PDF first page (we'll use that to correlate).

Minimal CSV schema (column order recommended but not strict):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price_local
- line_total_local
- tax_rate_percent
- tax_amount_local
- po_number
- vendor_tax_id (optional but preferred)
- vendor_reference (optional)

Sample CSV row (single-PO, VAT line-level):
"INV6789",2026-09-01,USD,"Consulting — Sept",1,5000.00,5000.00,20.0,1000.00,PO12345,LV-9981,"Month 9 charge"

If you must supply multiple POs on the same invoice but the invoice line totals map to distinct POs, repeat lines with the appropriate po_number. If it's a single consolidated fee that applies to multiple POs, use semicolon-separated PO values and include a short "po_allocation" comment in vendor_reference describing split percentages.

Credit memos / negative invoices:
- Send as a separate file with invoice_type=credit_memo in the header row and reference the original invoice_number in vendor_reference. Portal will route to reconciliation.

Attachments and limits:
- Portal: please upload one CSV plus optional supporting PDFs (maximum 5 attachments).
- Email fallback: attach the PDF invoice and a single CSV export if available. PDFs must have the summary table on page 1.

Operational SLA and escalation:
- If portal push succeeds but does not ACK within 30 minutes, please open a ticket (HS-Deal-15473) and include the portal transaction id.

Let me know if you'd like us to test a sample push this week — we can stand up a sandbox endpoint and validate one sample file.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx

Marissa — this is perfect, thank you. We'll: 1) enable portal CSV push and test against the sandbox this Friday, and 2) send two fallback PDFs for the first run to ap@redwood.com with the X-Redwood-File-Ref header as you specified.

Two quick follow-ups: can we include up to 8 line-level PDF attachments for supplemental supporting docs, or should we consolidate into a single PDF? Also, for credit memos that reference multiple invoices, do you prefer one credit_memo file referencing all invoices or separate credit memos per invoice?

I'll set up the sandbox push and ping you when we attempt the first file.

Thanks,
Tom
Lumen Health — AP

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-04T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Questions on invoice submission (portal vs email) + VAT lines

Tom — quick answers to your follow-ups:
- Attachments: portal accepts up to 10 supporting attachments, but for email fallback please consolidate into a single PDF (ops team tools have trouble reliably associating multiple forensic PDFs). If you must send multiple PDFs via email, include a manifest page in the first PDF with filenames listed.
- Credit memos: preferred is one credit_memo file per original invoice for ease of automatic reconciliation. If it's not possible, a single credit_memo referencing multiple invoice_numbers is acceptable but will require manual review and may delay processing.

Look forward to the sandbox test. If you want, Marissa can schedule a 30-minute validation call during the push.

Irene Choi
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
